Metric logic at chrome.py:128-140 will fail with KeyError when trying to access rule['type'] since the rule dict only has 'tabs' key
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change expected structure to flat format: {"type": "rule", "rules": {"type": "url", "urls": ["https://paperswithcode.com/"]}} and modify get_rule to extract rules['rules']
OR: Modify is_expected_tabs metric to handle nested 'tabs' structure and support 'contains' operator for URL matching
OR: Create new metric function that properly handles the current rule format with 'tabs' array and 'contains' operator
